headline: Gaza toll reaches 74,640 killed, 175,947 injured (Health Ministry Nov 8 release)
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Gaza Health Ministry (Nov 8 release): 74,640 Palestinians killed and 175,947 injured since Oct 7 2023. Since the ceasefire took effect Oct 10 2025: 1,610 killed, 5,819 injured, 849 bodies recovered from beneath the rubble.
sources: ABNA -- 'Gaza death toll rises to 74,640 since October 2023, health ministry says' (https://en.abna24.com/news/1887876/Gaza-death-toll-rises-to-74-640-since-October-2023-health-ministry) + Al Jazeera liveblog Nov 9 10:30
fault_line: 74,640 dead -- and 1,610 of them AFTER the ceasefire. Is this a ceasefire, or a slower war?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Gaza Health Ministry (Nov 8 release): 74,640 Palestinians killed and 175,947 injured since Oct 7 2023. Since the ceasefire took effect Oct 10 2025: 1,610 killed, 5,819 injured, 849 bodies recovered from beneath the rubble. [SCOPE DISCIPLINE -- 2026-10-28 rule] This is the TOTAL toll. It must never be mixed with the UN Commission of Inquiry's narrow subset (at least 196 killed along the advancing front, Oct 26 report) -- the subset is not the toll. [NUMBER-SCOPE NOTE] The older bulletin (Nov 4, via Democrata/Yeni Safak) read 74,618 killed / 175,920 injured and 1,602 / 5,794 since the ceasefire -- SUPERSEDED by the Nov 8 release; do not use. AJ's other piece citing 74,040 is an Oct 1 article and is stale.
sections.what_verified: Primary source itself: the Gaza Health Ministry's own dated release (primary_source_single_family: true -- the ministry is the actor for its own toll data), carried by Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA). ABNA/Siasat/UK Fact Check carry the same release but have NO declared tier and do not count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: No independent verification of the totals exists; the ministry's own named list (72,835 individually identified, per UK Fact Check) sits below the headline total. Israel does not publish a Gaza toll. The since-ceasefire figure (1,610) is the ministry's count of killings during a 'ceasefire' -- the framing is contested, the count is the ministry's.
sections.why_matters: The toll just passed 74,600 -- and 1,610 of those deaths came AFTER the ceasefire began. The number is the story; the scope is the headline.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP + IN-WINDOW RESTATEMENT -- Gaza toll reaches 74,640 killed, 175,947 injured (Health Ministry Nov 8 release); 1,610 killed since the ceasefire began -- NEVER recorded in today's scans until now (AJ liveblog restates 'nearly 74,000' at 10:30 GMT = 14:30 )

totw_analysis: Our read: The toll just passed 74,600 -- and 1,610 of those deaths came AFTER the ceasefire began. The number is the story; the scope is the headline.
